instruction: Given a goal and two solutions, choose the correct one. Answer with A or B.
input:
Goal: How to sync your iPhone with Ford Sync?
(A) Make sure that your iPhone, your car, and the car’s radio/SYNC system is turned on. Open Settings on your iPhone and select “General”. Turn Bluetooth ON on the iPhone. Do not exit the Bluetooth menu of your iPhone. On the Car stereo display press the SYNC phone button. SYNC will begin searching for a phone to pair with. If it finds your iPhone, it will display a 6-digit code on its screen. Select “Add your phone” from the SYNC menu and then press "OK". SYNC will state “Press OK to begin pairing your device,” so press “OK” again. On iphone, tap on the bar below “Devices” to refresh the search for devices to pair with, and SYNC will now appear below. Tap it and you will be asked for the PIN. Enter the 6-digit PIN provided by SYNC. Press “Done” at the top of the screen to begin pairing. SYNC will then notify you on its screen that your iPhone is connected.
(B) Make sure that your iPhone, your car, and the car’s radio/SYNC system is turned on. Open Settings on your iPhone and select “General”. Turn Bluetooth OFF on the iPhone. Exit the Bluetooth menu of your iPhone.Press the SYNC phone button on the Car stereo display. SYNC will begin searching for a phone to pair with. If it finds your iPhone, it will display a 6-digit code on its screen. Select “Add your phone” from the SYNC menu and then press "OK". SYNC will state “Press OK to begin pairing your device,” so press “OK” again. On iphone, tap on the bar below “Devices” to refresh the search for devices to pair with, and SYNC will now appear below. Tap it and you will be asked for the PIN. Enter the 6-digit PIN provided by SYNC. Press “Done” at the top of the screen to begin pairing. SYNC will then notify you on its screen that your iPhone is connected.
Answer:
